headline: Alibaba launches Qwen4-Max, which it says cuts cost per task
body: Alibaba launched Qwen4-Max, a mixture-of-experts model with 2.4 trillion parameters that activates 71 billion per token, according to the Qwen team. According to Alibaba, the average cost per Work360 task falls 62 percent, from $4.43 to $1.67. Through its own API, Alibaba charges $1.50 per million input tokens and $4.50 per million output tokens.
note: The cost figures come from Alibaba's own Work360 benchmark, and the page says Qwen4-Max trails Opus 5.5 and the GPT models on Humanity's Last Exam.

evidence.text: Alibaba launched Qwen4-Max, whose revamped architecture processes long texts more efficiently and with less compute.
The mixture-of-experts model has 2.4 trillion parameters but activates only 71 billion per token, according to the Qwen team.
Work360 is Alibaba's own benchmark for industrial work tasks across 721 specialized fields.
According to Alibaba, the average cost per Work360 task falls 62 percent, from $4.43 to $1.67.
Results on external benchmarks are mixed.
It trails Opus 5.5 and the GPT models on Humanity's Last Exam.
Through its own API, Alibaba charges $1.50 per million input tokens and $4.50 per million output tokens.
Qwen4-Max is Alibaba's answer to Opus 5.5, GPT-6, and Kimi K3.1 Pro.
The new flagship pairs a more efficient architecture with much lower prices and targets professional work in industry, science, and finance.
